context.description: The Gantt draws each lane from the task's spans

evidence.trustReason: The status fixtures carry explicit spans and harness tags, and the real GanttView renders over a real taskView actor. Full lane strings distinguish spans ending inside a cell at 30.4 versus 30.6 seconds, a span too short to hold a cell midpoint, blank cells before the first span and after the last, and an entirely blank lane with no spans. An open building span fills to now in a live view, to the heartbeat in a still view, and to endedAt for an ended run, with axis checks. Zero-length trusted, failed, cancelled and blocked final spans each take one cell; the blocked cell colour is asserted against the warning theme. Each Gherkin outcome has a rendered assertion.
